_note: Network-wide settings. Hole names are real Martian craters.

deposits._note: How many deposits of each kind a game places, and their size in degrees. Where they go follows the terrain (src/sim/map.ts).

firstSite._note: The first hole sits on northern-lowland ice between these latitudes, with ore or silica under it.

seedKit._note: What a staging bay gathers before a new hole can be founded, and how long a fully staffed bay takes to gather it. It never takes a hole below reserveFraction of a kit's worth of anything. Oxygen is in the kit because a new hole has no life support yet.
